name: motorbaldi-platform
description: MotorBaldi Platform foundation targeting Cloudflare Workers, D1, R2, Queues and Durable Objects.

scripts.lint: eslint apps packages scripts tests && prettier --check README.md 'apps/**/*.{ts,md,json,jsonc}' 'packages/**/*.{ts,json}' 'scripts/**/*.ts' 'scripts/**/*.mjs' 'tests/**/*.ts' 'docs/{architecture,cloudflare,contracts,runbooks,adr}/*.md'
scripts.build: pnpm build:portal && pnpm build:admin && pnpm build:api && pnpm build:worker
scripts.build:environments: for app in api worker portal admin; do for target in development staging production; do wrangler deploy --config apps/$app/wrangler.jsonc --env $target --dry-run --outdir dist/$app-$target; done; done
scripts.d1:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply motorbaldi-core-dev --local --config apps/api/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.test: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:workers && pnpm openapi:check && pnpm boundaries:check && pnpm security:check
scripts.security:scan:dist: node scripts/foundation/security.mjs dist && node scripts/foundation/security.mjs apps/portal/dist && node scripts/foundation/security.mjs apps/admin/dist && node scripts/foundation/security.mjs apps/api/dist && node scripts/foundation/security.mjs apps/worker/dist
scripts.gate: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm boundaries:check && pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:workers && pnpm openapi:check && pnpm security:check && pnpm audit --audit-level high && pnpm build && pnpm build:environments && pnpm security:scan:dist
